modeChooser.prompt: How would you like to set up the connection?
modeChooser.describeDescription: Tell us what you want to connect to and AI drafts the connection for you.
modeChooser.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured for your organization.
modeChooser.manualDescription: Enter the base URL, authentication, and access rules yourself.

automatic.intro: Describe what you want to connect to and AI will prefill the connection — you review every step and paste the credential yourself.
automatic.placeholder: I want to connect to Google Sheets to read spreadsheet data…
automatic.aiUnavailableBody: Your organization has no AI provider configured, so the connection can't be drafted automatically. You can still set it up manually.

connect.intro: Give your connection a name and the base URL of the API your data apps should be able to call.
connect.baseUrlDescription: The remote origin apps may call (https only, no path)

access.usageNotesDescription: Helps the AI use this API correctly when building apps: key endpoints, pagination, quirks

testStep.intro: Send a test request to confirm the connection works before saving it. This step is optional.
testStep.saveSample: Save this response as an example to ground app generation

test.imageOnly: This image-only connection does not allow proxied requests, so there is nothing to test here.

edit.instructionsIntro: Notes on how apps should use this API — auth quirks, pagination, which endpoints matter, response caveats. Passed to the app builder when generating apps, alongside the technical spec. Markdown is supported.
edit.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Paginate with ?page= and ?per_page=. The /issues endpoint returns open issues only unless state=all is passed.

examples.title: Test connection and add examples
examples.description: Send a real request through this connection and optionally save it as a sample for app generation.
examples.sampleQueued: A tested sample is queued and will be added when you save the connection.
examples.queryParamsDescription: Sent as URL query params. Tip: paste a URL with a query string into the path field to fill these in automatically.
examples.savedAfterConnection: The sample will be added after you save the connection.
examples.samplesGround: Saved samples ground Claude in the API response shape.
examples.noSamplesRunTest: No saved samples yet — run a test above and save it.

delete.filesWarning_one: This will also delete {{count}} file stored with this theme. Any content currently using this theme will keep its files but won't inherit future edits.

detail.extraInstructionsHelp: These will be passed to the agent alongside any markdown files. These can be any instructions you want included.
detail.extraInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Use sentence case for all headings. Prefer dense layouts over generous whitespace.
detail.defaultDescription: The default theme is automatically applied to new content. Individual items can override it.
detail.filesHelp: Drag & drop CSS, font, image, or markdown instruction files. They'll be picked up automatically wherever this theme is applied.
detail.overLimit: This theme is over the {{max}} limit (currently {{used}}). Apps won't apply it until you remove some assets.
detail.nearLimit: This theme is getting large ({{used}} of {{max}}). Large themes are slower to generate and can fail to apply — keep only the assets you need.
detail.deleteAllDescription_one: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} file from "{{name}}"?
detail.deleteAllDescription_other: Are you sure you want to delete all {{count}} files from "{{name}}"?
detail.deleteAllBody: The theme itself is kept, along with its description, extra instructions, and anything already using it.
